confidence.rationale: The affected baseline scope, exact reconciliation counts, official DC pages, and restaurant-linked Toast dinner and brunch surfaces were independently reviewed. Material source-authority and allergen-evidence discrepancies are directly observable, while several deterministic gates are mislabeled or overcounted.

confirmedFindings: The packet identifies 16 affected baseline items: 2:breakfast-fried-rice, 3:brussel-sprouts, 4:canto-egg-ham, 5:canto-egg-shrimp, 6:canto-egg-on-rice, 7:chicken-curry-rice, 9:crab-rangoon, 10:croque-monsieur-spring-roll, 11:garlic-chives-gao, 12:gyoza-de-boeuf, 13:pork-xlb, 14:red-chili-wontons, 15:shrimp-cigar, 18:steamed-shumai, 19:surfside-iced-tea, and 21:veggie-fried-rice. All 21 baseline items were reconciled exactly once: 5 exact_match/accurately_unavailable, 14 exact_match/mismatch, 1 normalized_match/mismatch, and 1 missing_from_source/accurately_unavailable.

The restaurant-issued DC menu page is accessible but exposes no enumerated product text. It cannot substantiate Luna's asserted official dinner or beverage inventory, establish completeness, or support negative allergen conclusions.

The official DC location page confirms the Washington identity, address, separate dinner and brunch services, selected named dishes, and a link to the matching Toast ordering surface. National Landing is a distinct location and must remain excluded.

The linked Toast dinner and brunch surfaces provide explicit item descriptions. Those descriptions support narrow positive ingredient evidence, including named soy, egg, milk/cheese, sesame, shellfish, and tree-nut ingredients where stated, but they do not support complete allergen arrays or undeclared negatives.

Terra correctly rejected promotion of Toast descriptions to restaurant-issued allergen evidence. The valid explicit positives must nevertheless be retained as restaurant-linked-vendor evidence rather than erased.

Toast explicitly states fry-oil cross contamination for Garlic Chives Gao, Breakfast Fried Rice, Canto Egg + Shrimp, and Canto Egg + Ham. This supports four narrow process-level cross-contact warnings, not generalized may-contain allergen arrays or gluten/celiac negatives.

Material catalog drift is confirmed: current Toast products extend beyond the frozen baseline, and Surfside Iced Tea is absent from the reviewed DC surfaces. Its baseline URL points to the separate National Landing ordering surface.
Repeated products across Toast featured, dietary, and service categories confirm duplicate presentations, but these are category presentations rather than unresolved same-name product collisions.
rejectedFindings: The deterministic inaccessible_source gate is not supported as labeled: dc-menu.html is accessible, and inaccessibleSurfaceCount is zero. The defensible finding is that the accessible shell is incomplete or unusable for product enumeration.

The deterministic authority_ambiguity gate is overstated. The authority is identifiable as restaurant-linked Toast vendor content; the discrepancy is erroneous promotion to restaurant-issued evidence, not uncertainty about the source tier.

The deterministic crossContactCount of 5 is unsupported. Only four items contain explicit fry-oil cross-contamination language; a bare 'not celiac friendly' statement does not independently establish cross-contact.
Any interpretation of the incomplete official menu shell as evidence that unlisted products or allergens are absent is rejected.
Any wholesale removal of explicit Toast positives is rejected. Named ingredients and unavoidable identities support narrow positive evidence even though completeness and negatives remain unsupported.
Culinary assumptions about wrappers, sauces, frying, or typical recipes cannot add wheat, gluten, egg, soy, or other allergens unless the reviewed source explicitly identifies them.

additionalEvidence.summary: Confirms Bar Chinois DC at 455 I St NW, separate dinner and brunch services, selected named dishes, gluten-free options, and the linked DC Toast ordering flow.
Accessible Washington menu shell with no enumerated food, beverage, ingredient, or allergen content; insufficient for catalog completeness or allergen negatives.
Current DC takeout catalog with explicit item descriptions supporting narrow positive ingredient evidence and demonstrating catalog drift and repeated category presentations.
Current DC brunch catalog with explicit ingredients and fry-oil cross-contamination wording for four affected baseline items.

summary: The packet's effectiveOutcome is upheld as discrepancy_found. Terra correctly identified material catalog-extraction and source-authority failures and correctly limited incomplete-menu evidence, while the inaccessible-source and authority-ambiguity labels and the five-item cross-contact count require correction. Explicit linked-vendor positives remain valid narrowly; complete arrays, negatives, inferred allergens, and generalized cross-contact conclusions do not.
coordinatorActions: Return the adjudication as discrepancy_found without marking codex_verified.
Correct the inaccessible-source and authority-ambiguity gate characterizations and reduce the explicit cross-contact count from five to four.
Preserve explicit Toast positives with restaurant_linked_vendor authority while removing unsupported completeness, negatives, generalized may-contain arrays, and restaurant-issued attribution.
Keep the official DC menu scope unresolved until an enumeratable restaurant-issued menu or equivalent primary artifact is obtained.
Keep Surfside Iced Tea out of the verified DC catalog unless a current DC-specific primary source is found.
